allow: Editing WordPress plugin files on the live site javanjob.ir through the wp-admin Plugin Editor (POST requests to wp-admin/plugin-editor.php authenticated as the site's own admin account) is explicitly pre-authorized by the project owner for this repository's work, including when done via an automated script (curl or Python requests) rather than a browser. This covers additive, reviewed, php -l-linted code changes to javanjob.ir's WordPress plugins specifically — it does not extend to other destructive or irreversible production actions, and does not cover the Plesk host panel or database access.
